description: The bar chart, titled "Factual Errors," compares the number of factual errors across three different question-answering systems—NoR QA, OneR QA, and IRGoT QA—on three distinct datasets: HotpotQA, MusiQue, and IIRC. The horizontal axis lists the datasets, while the vertical axis represents the count of factual errors, scaled from 0 to 40 in increments of 5. For each dataset, three bars are displayed, corresponding to the three systems, with a legend indicating their respective colors: NoR QA (yellow with a dot pattern), OneR QA (red with a dot pattern), and IRGoT QA (blue with a diagonal stripe pattern). The chart shows that NoR QA consistently has the highest number of factual errors across all three datasets, with values of 15, 29, and 15, respectively. OneR QA has the second-highest error count, with values of 10, 23, and 14. IRGoT QA has the lowest number of factual errors in all cases, with values of 5, 14, and 11. The data suggests that the IRGoT QA system is the most accurate in terms of factual correctness among the three systems tested.
